{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "state_declined",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "asset_category",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean, well-separated categorical variable (hardware/travel/cloud_service/etc.) that can be grouped and compared against decline rates. Interpretable and external to the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "asset_brand_vendor",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Vendor/brand is an interpretable associational dimension; despite some NULLs the categories are distinct and segmentable for comparing decline behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "action_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct action categories provide a meaningful axis to segment records and compare against decline rates."
    },
    {
      "name": "creation_method",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Binary manual/automated with a balanced split (320/180); highly interpretable and a plausible signal for review outcome. Strong EDA segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "description_specificity",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Directly relevant to the query about description signals; three well-separated, interpretable levels that can be compared against decline outcomes."
    },
    {
      "name": "has_source_id",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean flag with a usable split (327/173); interpretable and segmentable, offers a data-completeness axis to compare against declines."
    },
    {
      "name": "is_luxury_or_premium",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Conceptually relevant (premium items may be scrutinized) but the split is near-constant (488 false vs 12 true), so meaningful comparison is weak — too rare to draw stable relationships."
    },
    {
      "name": "department_group",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable organizational segmentation with distinct categories; useful for comparing decline rates across groups. Partly redundant with original 'department' but coarser/cleaner."
    },
    {
      "name": "hardware_subtype",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable subtype categories; though heavily NULL for non-hardware rows, it still supports segmentation within the hardware slice."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 9,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "The set offers mostly clean, interpretable, well-separated categorical variables external to state_declined that a human can group on and compare against decline outcomes (creation_method, description_specificity, asset_category, action_type, has_source_id are especially strong). Several are directly aligned with the query's focus on description/process signals. Weaknesses: is_luxury_or_premium is near-constant and gives little comparative leverage, department_group partially restates an existing column, and hardware_subtype/asset_brand_vendor carry substantial NULLs that fragment segmentation. Overall a genuinely exploratory, understanding-oriented set rather than opaque scores, but with a few low-yield columns."
}
